parameters.name: ASMGatewayName
parameters.description: The name of the ASM gateway.

parameters.name: ServiceNames
parameters.description: The names of the services. Separate multiple service names with commas (,). Example: reviews,sleep.

parameters.name: ServiceNamespace
parameters.description: The namespace in which the service resides.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh update-asm-gateway-imported-services --service-mesh-id c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --service-names reviews,sleep --asm-gateway-name ingressgateway --service-namespace default --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh UpdateASMGatewayImportedServices --region cn-hangzhou --ServiceMeshId c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --ServiceNamespace default --ServiceNames 'reviews,sleep' --ASMGatewayName ingressgateway
